questions.question: Does EdCoach AI replace our formal evaluation system?
questions.answer: No, EdCoach AI is designed to supplement—not replace—your formal evaluation process. It streamlines informal feedback and growth between formal observations.

questions.question: How do teachers access their feedback?
questions.answer: Teachers have a secure portal to view all feedback interactions, both informal and formal, in a clear, organized feed.

questions.question: Can I save and finalize walkthroughs later?
questions.answer: Yes! You can save walkthroughs and observations as drafts and finalize them when you're ready to share feedback.

questions.question: Is EdCoach AI mobile-friendly and does it work offline?
questions.answer: Absolutely. EdCoach AI is designed for mobile use in classrooms and supports offline completion with automatic sync when reconnected.

questions.question: How secure is our school's data?
questions.answer: Extremely. We use industry-leading partners (Convex & Clerk) for encrypted storage, secure authentication (MFA available), and adhere to strict data privacy protocols designed for education.

questions.question: What integrations are available?
questions.answer: We are actively developing integrations with systems like Google Classroom, Clever, and Apple School Manager. District partners often get early access.

questions.question: Is there a free trial or pilot program?
questions.answer: We plan to offer trials and pilot programs. Join the waitlist to be the first to know about availability and receive early access opportunities!

questions.question: How does role-based access work?
questions.answer: Principals, coaches, and teachers each have access to the features and data relevant to their role, ensuring privacy and clarity for everyone.
